claim_text: Risk factors for MPNST in NF1 include a large internal neurofibroma burden, numerous subdermal neurofibromas, atypical neurofibromas, neurofibromatous neuropathy, previous radiotherapy, a personal or family history of MPNST, and NF1 microdeletions.
